title: Lechona
description: Lechona is a dish from Colombia featuring pork shoulder, garlic, orange juice, white rice. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Small home lechona-style pork roast with rice stuffing, not a whole deboned stuffed pig.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 90 minutes.
Cook the measured rice with stock and peas until tender, cool promptly, and use this cooked mixture as the stuffing for the pork roast.
Hollow or prepare the vegetables, then fill with the prepared mixture without packing too tightly.
Roast the already seasoned food in a preheated oven until tender and safely cooked, using a thermometer for meat or poultry.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
